name: Fish Speech
overview: A state-of-the-art multilingual TTS system supporting over 80 languages with zero-shot cloning.
details: Fish Speech utilizes a transformer-based architecture to deliver extremely high-quality, expressive speech across multiple languages.
It requires dedicated VRAM (typically 12GB+) and is heavily optimized for Nvidia GPUs and AMD ROCm, making it ideal for the Tier 2 Compute Plane.
